items: HIGH QUALITY BUILD QUALITY — Forged from high-quality steel and finished in high-polish chrome provides plenty of strength, durability, and anti-corrosion protection. All the tools meet or exceed ANSI critical standards.

WIDE RANGE OF TOOLS — Our home tool set comes with a rich collection of tools to suit any job. You will receive combination wrenches, long nose pliers, polished quick release ratchet, adjustable wrench, rip claw hammer, measure tape rule, drive sockets and more.

COMPLETE HOUSEHOLD TOOL SET — Contains tools needed for most small repairs and basic DIY projects around the house.Perfect for Handyman’s, repairmen, mechanics, body shops etc. Also a great tool set to have at home, garage and the workshop.

STORAGE CASE FOR PORTABILITY — This tool set comes with a sturdy case to protect and house all your tools in one place. This makes it easy to carry tools aroundto your area of work whilst keeping everything neatly organized and ready to store away when you’re done.

COMPACT TOOL SET — The case is tight and compact, and features a dirt-resistant design with a diamond shape pattern. The overall dimensions of the small tool set case is 15.7” x 11” x 3.4”. Overall, this basic tool set has a net weight of 10.25 lbs.
